summary: Consent-gated ad loading over the Google Mobile Ads and UMP SDKs, with banner, interstitial and opt-in rewarded formats that never request inventory before consent resolves.

permissions.name: com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID
permissions.why: Declared by the Google Mobile Ads SDK to serve and measure ads; removing it disables the advertising ID and reduces ad revenue.

dataCollected.notes: Advertising ID, used for ad delivery and measurement; disabled by consent refusal in the EEA/UK.
Ad interaction events (impressions, clicks, rewarded completions) reported by the ad SDK.
Ad SDK diagnostics and crash data reported by the SDK itself.

policyNotes: Data safety is not optional once this module is present: the app must declare advertising ID collection and select an ads declaration in App content, even when no ad is ever shown.
requiresConsent is true because a personalised ad request before the user resolves the UMP form violates EEA/UK obligations; AdsController.canRequestAds() is the gate and starts false.

Families policy is much stricter than this module can enforce: an app that targets children must not use this capability as-is, because it would require child-directed ad inventory and a verified ad SDK configuration.
Rewarded formats must stay opt-in. The Disruptive Ads policy forbids a full-screen ad on launch or one that blocks the app's own function.
If a slot adds a second ad network directly instead of through this module, this manifest and the Data safety form must be updated in the same change.
